verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents built-in support for agents from several model vendors (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok) plus BrowserUse, and its agents overview mentions both open-source frameworks and model-native agents, so it is not locked to one vendor. Nothing in the evidence shows a developer plugging in an arbitrary LLM provider or their own API keys, including within the open-source HyperAgent framework. Missing for 10: documented bring-your-own-provider/API-key configuration, HyperAgent LLM-provider selection docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of model switching.
